features.sectionTitle: Everything You Need to Manage Your Budget
features.sectionSubtitle: Powerful features designed to make budget management simple and effective.

multiUser.title: Multi-User Support
multiUser.description: Collaborate with family members or team members. Share budgets and track expenses together.

groupBudgeting.title: Group-Based Budgeting
groupBudgeting.description: Create separate budgets for different groups - family, business, or personal projects.

realTime.title: Real-Time Tracking
realTime.description: Track expected vs actual expenses in real-time. See where your money is going instantly.

secure.title: Secure & Encrypted
secure.description: Your financial data is encrypted at rest. Bank-level security for your peace of mind.

categories.title: Custom Categories
categories.description: Create custom expense categories that match your lifestyle and spending patterns.

reports.title: Detailed Reports
reports.description: Generate comprehensive reports to understand your spending habits and make better decisions.

benefits.sectionSubtitle: Join thousands of users who have transformed their financial lives.

saveMoney.title: Save More Money
saveMoney.description: Users save an average of 20% more when actively tracking their budgets.

reduceStress.title: Reduce Stress
reduceStress.description: Know exactly where your money is going and eliminate financial anxiety.

achieveGoals.title: Achieve Goals
achieveGoals.description: Set and reach your financial goals faster with clear visibility.
